mapper.select: select p.id, p.leibieId, p.title, p.jieshao, p.image, p.price, p.kucun, c.mingcheng as categoryName, coalesce(( select sum(oi.shuliang) from t_order_item oi where oi.productId = p.id ), 0) as sales from t_product p left join t_leibie c on c.id = p.leibieId where p.id = #{id} and p.del = 'no'

select (select count(*) from t_product where del = 'no') as productCount, (select count(*) from t_product where del = 'no' and kucun <= 95) as lowStockCount, (select count(*) from t_user where del = 'no') as userCount, (select count(*) from t_order) as orderCount, (select count(*) from t_order where zt = '待发货') as pendingShipmentCount, (select coalesce(sum(zongjine), 0) from t_order) as revenue

select p.id, p.title, p.price, p.kucun as stock, c.mingcheng as categoryName from t_product p left join t_leibie c on c.id = p.leibieId where p.del = 'no' and p.kucun <= #{threshold} order by p.kucun asc, p.id desc limit #{limit}

select p.id, p.title, p.price, p.kucun as stock, c.mingcheng as categoryName, coalesce(sum(oi.shuliang), 0) as sales, coalesce(sum(oi.shuliang * oi.jiage), 0) as amount from t_product p left join t_leibie c on c.id = p.leibieId left join t_order_item oi on oi.productId = p.id where p.del = 'no' group by p.id, p.title, p.price, p.kucun, c.mingcheng order by sales desc, p.id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update t_order set zt = '已发货' where id = #{id} and zt = '待发货'
